concept_uz: 6-oktabrdagi «Oʻn yetti tuya» videosining javobi. Dono ayol oʻz tuyasini podaga qoʻshadi — 18 ta boʻladi: 9, 6, 2 — jami 17, bittasi ortib qoladi, u uniki. Sirri: ½ + ⅓ + ⅑ = 17/18. Oldingi videodagi R1–R7 rasmlar saqlangan boʻlsa, qayta ishlating.

facts.claim: Ayol oʻz tuyasini qarzga beradi, tuyalar 18 ta boʻladi
18 ning yarmi 9 (katta), uchdan biri 6 (oʻrtancha), toʻqqizdan biri 2 (kenja); 9 + 6 + 2 = 17
Bitta tuya ortib qoladi — ayolning oʻzi, u uyiga oʻsha tuyada ketadi
½ + ⅓ + ⅑ = 17/18 — ota butun podani taqsimlamagan
Javob: oʻrtancha oʻgʻil 6 ta tuya oladi
Raund 1: ochilgan 2026-10-05, javobi 2026-10-12 da ochildi — bugun (2026-10-13) javob videosi ruxsat

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, warm late-afternoon desert light, fine dust in the air, 35mm film look, sand, terracotta brick and faded turquoise tile tones, old Silk Road folk-tale mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 wide shot of the courtyard of an old Bukhara-style caravanserai in late afternoon: a square sandy yard ringed by brick arcades, a turquoise-tiled arched gate, a stone well in the middle, about seventeen resting two-humped camels kneeling and standing around the yard with simple woven saddle blankets. No people.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek man of about 30, tall and broad, short black beard, serious frowning face, DARK GREEN striped chapan robe with a wide leather belt, black-and-white doppi skullcap, holding a rolled paper scroll, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of a thin Uzbek man of about 25, clean-shaven, worried quick eyes, plain beige shirt and trousers with a bright RED scarf tied round his neck, counting on his fingers, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

Vertical 9:16 full-body portrait of an Uzbek teenage boy of about 16, cheeky grin, messy hair under a BLUE embroidered skullcap tilted to one side, white shirt with rolled sleeves, a small wooden flute tucked in his belt, standing in a sandy caravanserai yard.

lines.text: Oʻtgan hafta: oʻn yetti tuya, uch oʻgʻil. Bugun — javob!

scenes.prompt: The frozen yard comes back to life with one loud ring of the brass bell: the brothers blink, the camels stir, the woman on her cream-white camel smiles. Fast push-in on her face. Audio: a sharp bell ring, then wind and camel grunts. An off-screen narrator says with excitement in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "O'tgan hafta: o'n yetti tuya, uch o'g'il. Bugun — javob!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Mening tuyamni ham podaga qoʻshinglar. Endi nechta boʻldi?

scenes.prompt: The elderly woman climbs down from her camel slowly and leads it by the red-tasselled bridle in among the herd; the brothers exchange puzzled looks. Audio: soft steps on sand, the bell swaying. She says in Uzbek with a slow, warm, smiling elderly woman voice of about 70: "Mening tuyamni ham podaga qo'shinglar. Endi nechta bo'ldi?" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The youngest brother in the blue skullcap counts the camels at lightning speed pointing his finger, then jumps; the eldest in the dark green chapan unrolls the scroll, reads it again and breaks into a slow proud smile. Comic timing. Audio: quick counting taps, a camel snort. The youngest brother shouts, thrilled, in Uzbek with a bright, cheeky teenage boy voice of about 16: "O'n sakkizta!" Then the eldest brother says, amazed, in Uzbek with a deep, firm young male voice of about 30: "O'n sakkizning yarmi — to'qqizta. Menga!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The middle brother with the red scarf counts on his fingers, gasps and claps; the youngest in the blue skullcap pats two camels on the neck. Audio: claps, a happy camel groan. The middle brother says, relieved and fast, in Uzbek with a quick, nervous young male voice of about 25: "Uchdan biri — oltita! Menga!" Then the youngest says happily in Uzbek with a bright, cheeky teenage boy voice of about 16: "To'qqizdan biri — ikkita. Menga!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Toʻqqiz, olti, ikki. Jami — oʻn yetti. Hech bir tuya kesilmadi!

scenes.prompt: The camels rise and walk to their new owners, forming three groups of nine, six and two; the woman's cream-white camel walks out alone and stops beside her at the well. Smooth overhead crane shot. Audio: many soft hooves on sand, bells. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "To'qqiz, olti, ikki. Jami — o'n yetti. Hech bir tuya kesilmadi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bittasi ortib qoldi. U — meniki. Rahmat, bolalarim!

scenes.prompt: The elderly woman pats her cream-white camel, climbs back onto it and turns it toward the gate; the brothers stare, then laugh and bow with a hand on the chest. Audio: the brass bell, warm laughter. She says with a wink in Uzbek with a slow, warm, smiling elderly woman voice of about 70: "Bittasi ortib qoldi. U — meniki. Rahmat, bolalarim!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Sirri: yarim, uchdan bir, toʻqqizdan bir — jami oʻn sakkizdan oʻn yetti. Ota butun podani boʻlmagan edi!

scenes.prompt: Slow aerial drone shot over empty golden sand dunes at sunset, long soft shadows sliding across the ridges, dust glowing in the light. No people, no animals. Audio: wind, one faraway bell. An off-screen narrator explains, slow and delighted, in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Sirri: yarim, uchdan bir, to'qqizdan bir — jami o'n sakkizdan o'n yetti. Ota butun podani bo'lmagan edi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Toʻgʻri javob — oltita. Siz topdingizmi? Izohda yozing! Yangi jumboq — powerty.uz/logic da.
